points.description: Names the three composting systems: windrow, static aerated pile, and in-vessel composting (any wording that clearly identifies them; about two of three clearly right is enough for most credit).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only one correct system is named (or two vaguely); 2 marks if two or three correct systems are named.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for naming at least about three quarters of the items, i.e. two or three of: windrow, static aerated piles, in-vessel. Informal wording or slight spelling errors are fine. Give 1 mark for one correct system; 0 for none or only vermicomposting/unrelated answers. Extra wrong items do not cost marks.
